subject: SDK Sidecar Adapter & Governance: PromptTools integration
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@prompttools.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring SDK sidecar approach for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — PromptTools had a great time poking at Redwood's latency profiles. We discussed the idea of a lightweight SDK sidecar that would live next to ISV runtimes (LangChain / LlamaIndex) to surface tracing hooks and an optional governance layer (prompt blocklists / model version pinning).

We have a small team ready to prototype and would like to validate two things quickly:
- An agreed minimal API surface for tracing events and token metadata (so our telemetry matches Redwood's).
- Expectations for governance controls (policy enforcement vs. advisory warnings).

Can we schedule a short working session this week with your PM/engineers? We'll bring a draft checklist and a stub adapter for the LangChain Python runtime.

Attachment: prompttools-integration-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Head of Integrations | PromptTools Inc
[sara@prompttools.com]

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@prompttools.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring SDK sidecar approach for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters

Sara — thanks for the note and the checklist. High level: we like the sidecar idea for ISVs because it keeps customer infra unchanged while letting partners add cross-cutting features.

Marissa (PM) and Karthik (runtime eng) are looped in — suggested agenda for a 45m working session:
- 10m: alignment on tracing schema and event names
- 15m: sidecar API (auth, batch vs streaming telemetry)
- 10m: governance modes (block / warn / log) and expected controls surface
- 10m: next steps + owners + a 2-week prototyping milestone

Can you do 4/19 at 11:00 PT? If not, propose two slots and we’ll land one.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
[Attachment referenced: prompttools-integration-checklist.xlsx]

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@prompttools.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring SDK sidecar approach for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters

Thanks — 4/19 11:00 PT works. We'll include one engineer from our LangChain team and a product owner.

Quick notes ahead of the meeting (so you can prep):
- Tracing schema: we propose name/value pairs for "span_type", "model_variant", "prompt_id", and a short token-usage vector (start_token, end_token). We can share a sample JSON payload.
- Governance: PromptTools wants a 'soft-block' mode that returns a sanitized candidate + audit log if a prompt triggers a policy. We realize Redwood may prefer enforcement at the serving layer for regulated customers; happy to support both.

We'll upload an updated checklist to the shared Drive and include a small SOW draft outlining timelines.

Best,
Sara
[DevPartner Solutions is copied for partner enablement]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@prompttools.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring SDK sidecar approach for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters — post-call summary + SOW draft

Hi all — thanks for the sync earlier. Recap and agreed next steps below.

Recap:
- Tracing: agreed on base schema (span_type, model_variant, prompt_id, token_offsets). Karthik will publish the example payload to the Drive folder linked below by EOD 4/21.
- Sidecar API: OAuth bearer token for auth; support both streaming (for live apps) and batched uploads (for high-throughput jobs).
- Governance modes: three modes accepted — enforce (block), soft-block (sanitize + audit), and monitor (log-only). Customers choose per deployment.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Karthik Iyer: payload examples + server-side ingestion contract (INT-952). ETA 2027-04-21.
- Ava Chen (SE): prototype LangChain adapter + demo notebook. ETA 2027-04-30.
- Marissa Cole: SOW draft + milestone-based rollout (2-week prototype -> pilot -> GA). Draft attached.
- Markus Klein: commercial alignment & partner enablement plan.

Attachments: redwood-connector-sow-draft.pdf (draft SOW), prompttools-integration-checklist.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPromptToolsIntegration
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INT-952

Notes on governance: For enterprise customers in regulated industries we'll recommend configuring the sidecar in 'enforce' mode at the serving tier; for self-serve ISVs, default to 'soft-block' to avoid surprising behavior. We'll capture these recommendations in the SOW.

Please confirm owners and dates; once confirmed I'll raise INT-952 and add the prototype tasks.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, ISV Integrations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment stubs included above]
